meta.extraction: vector (PyMuPDF page.get_drawings(), OCG layers), coordinates rotated to the displayed north-up frame X=uy, Y=842-ux; text via get_text("words"); no raster tracing
meta.worldFrame: metres; x = east, z = south (+z south, -z north), y = up; origin = centre of the site.pdf 22F tower rectangle (site page pt 1620.077, 762.686; 8.306 pt/m), same as src/scene/scale.ts pageToWorld()

scale.method: horizontal desk-module dimension chain at displayed y=397.28 pt (layer "0"), arrow tip to arrow tip, dims 1467/1445/1655/.../1878 mm
scale.crossCheck: column centre spacing on the 11.0 m axes (13F grid): 438.36 -> 649.44 pt = 211.08 pt = 11.002 m

transform.formula: X = uy, Y = 842 - ux (page rotation 270); x = X / pt_per_m + tx ; z = Y / pt_per_m + tz
transform.fit: least-squares translation (scale from dimension chain, rotation 0) on 23 columns matched to F13.json columns; F13 is registered to site.pdf (fit residuals <= 0.011 m). 12.pdf has no curtain-wall/fin envelope to fit to site.pdf directly.

registration.note: slabEdgeVsSiteOutline: 12F outline is the structural slab edge (板边线); site.pdf outline is the curtain-wall fin envelope, so the offsets are the facade depth, not registration error.

deskRule.rule: D046/D060: desk centre to column edge >= 1.10 m and desk bbox not intersecting columns
deskRule.note: desks kept exactly as drawn; violations are deviations, not moved

knownIssues: Outline is the structural slab edge (板边线); 12.pdf has no curtain-wall / fin envelope. It lies 0.57-0.98 m inside the site.pdf fin envelope (see registration.slabEdgeVsSiteOutline).
Registration is indirect: 12F columns fitted to F13.json columns (F13 is registered to site.pdf), not to site.pdf directly.

Room polygons are axis-aligned rectangles from ray-casting; polygon=null for: 1#卫, 1#楼梯, 1#电梯(消), 2#楼梯, 2#电梯, 3#电梯, 4#电梯, 5#电梯, 6#电梯, 7#电梯, 8#电梯, 9#电梯, IT部（96+1人）, 会议室, 卫排, 外廊, 女卫, 文档室, 档案室, 母婴, 油烟, 男卫, 茶水, 采购部（88+1人） (会议室 = the 29 m2 and 36 m2 labels; lifts: rays escaped through door openings).
Label areas differ from rectangles in several rooms (e.g. 茶室 35 m2 label vs 44.7; 一级主管办公室 33 vs 45.7).
24 desks in the east zone are rotated (1.8 x 0.7, facing N/S); 160 are 0.7 x 1.8 facing E/W. Desk rects reconstructed from line pairs around the 184 grommet circles.
A 0.3 m column sliver at the slab edge is excluded from columns.
elevation_m uses the scene formula 6 + (n-2)*4.2 = 48.0. 12.pdf has no level text. 8F.pdf labels the 8F level 35.650 (formula gives 31.2), so scene floor heights may be off; not resolved here.
No printed scale; scale from the desk-module dimension chain (cross-checked with 11 m column spacing).
Level: no absolute level on this sheet, so meta.levelFromDrawing = null; meta.levelExtrapolated 52.45 / 52.4(结) is an extrapolation from 8F (+4.2 m per storey), 4.45 m above the scene elevation 48.0.
meta.levelNote: No absolute level on this sheet (re-checked all text: none (12.pdf has no level text at all); no level symbol at the tower west core lobby where 2F-8F carry theirs).

levelExtrapolated.basis: NOT on a drawing: 8F 35.650 / 35.600(结) + 4.200 m per storey (the 4F-8F tower interval, identical for 4 storeys)

outlineType: slab edge (板边线, layer PLAN-F10-F22-P$0$banbianxian), NOT the curtain-wall envelope
